description.narrative: In November 2022 we visited Labour Party Kenya Youth Congress (LPKYC) as part of a Partner Identification. Since the trip, we have explored the opportunities for a potential project. We decided that we wanted to broaden out the target group for our project. To do so, we reached out to Siasa Place, which is an organisation that we shortly visited during the Partner Identification Trip. We also reached out to Leaders for Leaders Champion Organization (LLCO), where one of the project group members met with one from the organisation during PARTICIPATE 2022. In January we set up meetings with the different organisations to learn more about them, their values, and their work. We also discussed whether there would be a foundation for a potential project between the four of our organisations, which we believe there is. During the partner identification we want to meet with Siasa Place, LLCO and LPKYC to further investigate a future project, learn more about the context of a given project, and see how our organisations could work together on a specific project. We will also get to know the organisations, their values, and their capacities more. All of this will assist with laying the cornerstones for a potential preparatory study and hopefully future project collaboration.
